verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation are fair questions for an auth API service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version pinning, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe and the existence of client SDKs and API endpoints show a documented API surface, but they are adjacent and say nothing about versioning guarantees or deprecation timelines.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
